<section class="section">
<div class="section-lead">
<header>About Us</header>
<hr/>
</div>
<article>
<h2>Australia’s largest provider of industry-based research</h2>
<p>Since 1971, IBISWorld has been providing thoroughly researched, reliable and current business information that is considered priceless to many subscribers. Today, IBISWorld employs a team of dedicated expert analysts who research economic, demographic and government data so you don’t have to. We can provide your organisation with valuable insights on Australia’s 700+ industries, its top 2,000 companies and its key business environment indicators, so you can make better business decisions, faster.</p>
<a class="waves-effect waves-light btn btn-ibis ripple" href="/about/">Learn More</a>
</article>
</section>
</div>

<div class="solution-lead">
<h2>Industry Reports</h2>
</div>
<article>
<p>Powerful business tools that provide strategic insights and analysis on over 700 Australian industries. We produce Australia’s most comprehensive selection of reports, covering the entire economy – from Accounting Services to Zoos.</p>
<div class="link-set">

<p>Explore IBISWorld solutions by your occupation.</p>
<a class="btn btn-ibisclear no-padding" href="/industry-trends/role/">Read More</a>
</article>
</section>
</div>

<section class="section-solution company">
<div class="solution-lead bg-holder-company">
<h2>Company Research</h2>
</div>
<article>
<p>As a natural complement to our in-depth industry research reports, our top 2,000 Australian company profiles help you assess your competitors and prospects. Stay up-to-date with the nation's largest public, private and government enterprises.</p>
<div class="link-set">
<a class="btn btn-ibis ripple" href="/australian-company-research-reports/">Browse Reports</a>
</div>
<div class="dont-know-text">Don't know what to look for?</div>
<p>Find out how IBISWorld can help you.</p>

<p>Find out which Company Report products may best fit your requirements.</p>
<a class="btn btn-ibisclear no-padding" href="/australian-company-research-reports/">Read More</a>
</article>
</section>

</article>

<section class="section-whyibis">
<h2 class="text-center">Why IBISWorld?</h2>
<div class="row">
<div class="col-xs-12 col-md-4 margin-top-10">
<div class="why-ibis-item">
<div class="icn-independent"></div>
<label>INDEPENDENT</label>
<p>Unbiased research based on just the facts, we are completely independent and present our findings accordingly.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-xs-12 col-md-4 margin-top-10">
<div class="why-ibis-item">
<div class="icn-accurate"></div>
<label>ACCURATE</label>
<p>Our rigorous quality control systems ensure that our analysis, and the data it is based on, is thoroughly reviewed and cross-checked.</p>
</div>
</div>
<div class="col-xs-12 col-md-4 margin-top-10">
<div class="why-ibis-item">
<div class="icn-breadth"></div>
<label>BREADTH</label>
<p>With reports on thousands of industries, we have you covered. Our breadth of collection is unrivalled and provides broad utility.</p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
</section>
